catalogue.detailAccess: All entries belong to this experiment. Use consult ability with its ID to retain its full executable schema for subsequent decisions. Public implementation does not grant personal mastery.

request.name: Investigate unknown food safety
request.function: Investigate an actual owned hazelnut sample to determine whether there is a feasible way to establish food safety, nutrition and necessary preparation without ingesting an unknown toxin.
request.conditions: At tick 47 I observed a nearby mature hazelnut plant with stock 21. Observation revealed only plant state, not food properties. I intend to collect one sample. I have no known testing equipment or relevant mastery; roots and berries are my known safe foods.
request.inputs: Actual collected hazelnut sample; other required tools, materials and methods are unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify feasible time, effort, material requirements and limitations before testing.
request.effects: Return only evidence supported by actual feasible investigation, with uncertainties explicit. Do not assume that appearance proves safety or require blind ingestion.

shown.question: Can this local hazelnut be safely used as food, and does it require preparation?
evidence: At tick 47, direct observation showed the mature hazelnut plant with stock 21.
The observation did not establish nutrition or toxicity.
shown.uncertainty: Edibility, toxicity, nutrition and preparation requirements remain unknown.
shown.goal: Obtain evidence sufficient to decide whether to use this food without an unsafe tasting trial.
shown.missing: An actual sample and a feasible food-property investigation method.
shown.next: Gather one sample and request functional review.

input.contextPolicy: Object IDs refer to deduplicated actual applicant observations. Whole records are selected with omission counts. Missing detail is unknown, not proof of absence. Full retained state is available during the development handoff; implementation must validate actual prerequisites and ownership.
input.implementation: New interfaces, state, geometry, persistent processes, rendering components and personal memory/task adapters can be delivered through a versioned current-conversation handoff. Source validation and history must remain intact. Declared implementation does not supply stock, objects or mastery.
